changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-cisco-meraki` skill for working with Cisco Meraki through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Provides safe read-only access to Meraki data using the `oo` CLI and the `cisco_meraki` connector.
- Supports retrieving a device by serial number with `get_device`.
- Supports browsing organization inventory devices with `list_organization_inventory_devices`.
- Supports listing accessible networks with `list_organization_networks`.
- Supports listing available organizations with `list_organizations`.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@46cfb3e`
summary: Cisco Meraki (meraki.cisco.com). Use this skill for ANY Cisco Meraki request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves Cisco Meraki, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
